title: TAI exact-main preflight owner command
objective: Provide an owner-only exact-current-main command that dispatches the existing fail-closed TAI REG.RU preflight with its canonical target SHA and confirmation inputs.
boundaries: Command is accepted only on issue 3365
Comment author, workflow actor and triggering actor must be the repository owner
Target SHA is read from the current main ref immediately before dispatch
The existing TAI preflight retains exact-main, image revision, non-root user, immutable digest and protected REG.RU controller checks
No direct production mutation is performed by the command bridge
